detail.longDescription: Hey HN, I have always used the Claude Max 20x plan because my employer paid this for me. Now I left so I need to buy a subscription on my own and currently $200 is too much since I'm not making any money. What should I buy? ChatGPT Pro or Claude Max 5x? I just barely have enough usage with the 20x plan in Claude and that would be a good reason to switch to ChatGPT but I also really like Claude Fable 5(.1) because I'm sometimes super vague in my requests and it just figures it out. I've heard that GPT-6 Astra is crazy good but also not as 'smart' in figuring things out on it's own with a vague prompt. I've tried GPT-5.6 Sol last month and really hated it but I haven't tried GPT-6 Astra. So I have a dilemma. Do I continue to use the best model for me (Fable 5.1) but always reach my usage limits OR do I switch and hope that I don't hate GPT-6 Astra?
